blind_spots_patched: Baseline Ch 3 omitted quantitative customer concentration (77% of FY2025 gross product revenue from just two customers) and $176.1M in 9M 2026 temporary manufacturing interruption-related costs.

Baseline Ch 2 missed net selling price erosion on Eylea HD, the 1% YoY decline in combined U.S. Eylea + Eylea HD, the 23% YoY drop in Bayer ex-U.S. Eylea revenue, and the Sanofi Dupixent audit-rights lawsuit settlement.
Baseline Ch 4 omitted the Federal Circuit March 14, 2025 affirmance denying preliminary injunction against Amgen's 2 mg aflibercept biosimilar Pavblu and the June 2025 follow-on patent suit.

Baseline Ch 4 omitted U.S. 340B Drug Pricing Program expansion risk, IRA Medicare Part B inflation rebates, cross-border tariff exposure on Limerick, Ireland bulk supply, and OECD Pillar Two / 2025 OBBBA tax risks.

Baseline Ch 5 omitted Regeneron's dual-class Class A (10 votes/share) voting structure, the Sept 24, 2026 one-time 10-year CEO/CSO PSU awards and non-core subsidiary equity grants, and 2026 Form 4 activity.

Baseline Ch 6 omitted $1,577.9M uncertain tax position reserves (PwC CAM), $527.2M cash-tax vs. GAAP-tax gap, $720.0M finance lease liabilities, 9M 2026 CapEx acceleration ($771.0M), and +32% YTD AR surge ($7,578.6M).
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: Bayer Collaboration Revenue is a stable ex-U.S. 8 mg Eylea transition, Sanofi Q3 2026 collaboration revenue was $2,720.0M, and U.S. EYLEA 2 mg Q3 2026 sales were ~$401.0M.
CONFIRMED: FY2025 $100 unit-economics waterfall reconciles audited $14,342.9M revenue, $4,978.9M CFO, $898.4M CapEx, and $4,080.5M FCF with zero D&A double-counting.
CONFIRMED: Sanofi development balance was fully repaid in Q2 2026, eliminating the 20% profit-share deduction, and the 2026 Sanofi deal co-funds four long-acting antibodies.
WEAKENED: FY2025's 13.9% GAAP effective tax rate and $16.2B net cash reflect clean cash earnings and fortress liquidity.
